scope: Local implementation of F09 builder slice S4 plus the one-Pine attempt evaluator core (plan lane L7): BiFixturePackageService in src/postgres/bi-package-store.js builds one labelled fixture Best Inputs package from a stored v3 fixture research run and validates it through the package gates to a fixture EXPORT_VALIDATED with a fixture ql4c_validation row. Local engineering evidence only; no route, worker, runtime root, service, staging install or deployment imports or uses it.
method: Root pre-implementation rulings (memory capacity, terminal-entry lifetime, cancellation, commit retry bound, deadlock handling, cross-process exclusion, I bar) before dispatch; Sonnet coder (high); independent Sonnet tester with mutants on copies (PASS after one fix round that added the in-transaction B0 refusal test, killing the surviving mutant); Opus auditor (READY, P3 only) and re-audit (READY). PostgreSQL tests ran on throwaway clusters with real non-owner roles and the real Python interpreter. Depends on the v3 trace profile accepted at faa3179 under the owner GO for the local engine-closure change. Reports are kept locally, not tracked.

result: Local: bi-package-build 15 tests (14 pass, 1 skipped CI-only interpreter assertion) plus the in-transaction B0 refusal test added in the fix round (22 pass, 1 skipped with the static isolation test); static isolation 7/7; package-gate, render, trace, closure, selection and grant regressions pass. E1 runs the real research worker, real Python engine and trace driver, real renderer, B0, store and exposure register reader; every file and trace SHA-256 recomputed independently; the exposure register, quant_jobs and Pine tables unchanged by the build. Refusal matrix writes zero rows. Single-flight gives one reproduction; a two-instance final-transaction race gives one export; HOLDOUT invocations stay one across commit restarts. CI on f38048b passed all 9 checks (read by root at 16:33Z UTC), including the PostgreSQL job that asserts an interpreter under CI=true.
limits: Local engineering evidence only; nothing is installed, routed or wired; READY false; fixture labels forced.
Only E1 exercises the real engine per reproduction; other cases replay E1 engine replies on cloned runs and test mechanics.
defaultPorts are not exercised end to end (the private source gate is replaced in tests, as in the S3 acceptance).
No cross-process exclusion: single process only; duplicate pre-insert evaluation by two processes stays possible, which is why no runtime root may import the module.

Recorded limitations from the audit: record writers accept a caller method and operator role; the GATES test hook receives live references; export_id is not shape-checked; no constructor role guard (any wiring must add a fixture-role guard); stored file hashes are not compared with manifest entries on LOAD; live policy_version and input lock echo the binding (no live source before owner question Q3).
OD-21 (holdout trace content) stays open; only fixture packages may exist. No qualified real candidate, TradingView compile record or staging evidence exists, so F09-01 V and T are not affected.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root accepts the F09 one-Pine fixture build and attempt service as local engineering evidence (ruling SB183). Under Root ruling SB176 item 10 this meets the P6 bar for F09-01 stage I (a builder and an evaluator use the gate module, the tables, the renderer and the trace reproduction on the labelled fixture path; no route or view is needed for I). A successor scorecard may move F09-01 I from 0 to 1 citing this record; V and T stay as they are. No credit moves before that scorecard.
